metadata.case_name: TSANG YEE MAN v. CHANEL HONG KONG LTD FORMERLY KNOWN AS CHANEL LTD

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to the left foot and ankle
source: the plaintiff has 3 different diagnoses: i) soft tissue injury to the left foot and ankle ii) left heel plantar fasciitis / heel pad syndrome and iii) non‑specific left and right knee pain.

"If the injury had occurred in the manner described by Ms. Tsang at this assessment and also as documented in available documents and findings reports, it should be compatible with low energy soft tissue sprain injury to the left foot and ankle."
"For the uncomplicated soft tissue injury to her left foot and ankle, the prognosis should be good if not excellent."

"...the treatment, investigation and rehabilitation received by Ms. Tsang for her possible sprain injury to the left foot and ankle up to about 5 to 6 months should (be) considered adequate and reasonable."
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of ankle, unspecified

injuries.description: left heel plantar fasciitis / heel pad syndrome
source: the plaintiff has 3 different diagnoses: i) soft tissue injury to the left foot and ankle ii) left heel plantar fasciitis / heel pad syndrome and iii) non‑specific left and right knee pain.

"As for her left heel pain as reported by her at this assessment and also as documented in the previous available documents and reports, it was compatible with chronic plantar fasciitis or heel pad syndrome. According to the mechanism of injury as noted, it could not have any possible causal relationship with the alleged injury on 25 January 2013."

"In fact, at this assessment Ms. Tsang states clearly that after the injury, she noted pain and swelling over the left foot dorsum area and in this mechanism of injury could not possibly resulted in any heel pad syndrome or plantar fasciitis in the usual medical understanding and consideration."
"She reported diffuse tenderness along the left heel pad in the plantar area and diffuse tenderness around the heel."
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia or tendon at ankle or foot level

injuries.description: non‑specific left and right knee pain
source: the plaintiff has 3 different diagnoses: i) soft tissue injury to the left foot and ankle ii) left heel plantar fasciitis / heel pad syndrome and iii) non‑specific left and right knee pain.
"As for her left and right knee pain, simply there cannot be any causal relationship with the alleged injury."
"Physical examination showed unremarkable findings in both knees."
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the knee or lower leg, unspecified

manifestations.description: pain and swelling over the left foot dorsum area
left heel pain at the plantar surface / left heel cord pain
non‑specific left and right knee pain
mild decrease in girth in the left calf and left thigh
mild residual psychiatric symptoms / adjustment disorder with depressed mood

treatments_received: treatment from a Chinese bone setter
consulted various orthopaedic surgeons (private and public)
treatments_future: further psychiatric treatment (Dr. Lai suggested treatment could be terminated within 6 months of the joint examination, or within 3 months after the conclusion of the present litigation, whichever was later)
